This script failed to extract any data (resulting in an empty CSV file), which caused the subsequent analysis step to fail with an "EmptyDataError". The error occurred because the agent assumed the HTML structure of the OpenReview page was static and predictable without verifying the actual DOM structure or handling potential changes in the website's layout. The failure to extract data was the root cause of the inability to solve the real-world problem.
